chunks: And Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام said:
"Salat (prayer) is the means of nearness for every pious person."

key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ: salat (prayer), the act of worship that brings one near to Allah
key_terms.تَقِيٍّ: a pious and God-conscious person characterized by taqwa
key_terms.قُرْبَانُ: a means of nearness and approach to Allah

ai.seo_question: How does prayer bring a pious person nearer to Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that salat (prayer) is a means by which a person of taqwa draws near to Allah. It emphasizes the spiritual rank of prayer as an act of devotion and nearness, not merely a formal obligation.
